svg.title: Hen house input wiring
svg.desc: ESP32-S3 pins wired to the I2C devices, rotary encoder, door reed switches and reset button.
svg.text: ESP32 pins on the left, devices on the right. Follow each coloured line straight across.
I2C bus: OLED, RTC, SHT31, SHT30
All four devices share the same four wires:
Pin order is arranged for clarity. Find pins on your board by the GPIO numbers, not by position. Several 3V3 and GND pins exist: use a breadboard rail.
SHT31 address 0x45: join its ADDR pin to VIN. The SHT30 probe is fixed at 0x44. Keep the outside probe cable short.
